camel_example: aliyun cms PutEventRule --region cn-hangzhou --EventPattern.1.EventTypeList.1 Exception --EventPattern.1.LevelList.1 CRITICAL --EventPattern.1.StatusList.1 Failed --EventPattern.1.Product ecs --EventPattern.1.SQLFilter '192.168.XX.XX_and_Executed' --EventPattern.1.NameList.1 Agent_Status_Stopped --EventPattern.1.CustomFilters Stopping --RuleName myRuleName
description_en: Creates or modifies an event-based alert rule by calling the PutEventRule operation
description_zh: 调用PutEventRule接口创建或修改事件的报警规则
name: PutEventRule

parameters.help_en: The name of the Event-triggered Alert Rule
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application group to which the Event-triggered Alert Rule belongs
parameters.help_zh: 事件报警规则所属的应用分组ID
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the Event-triggered Alert Rule. Valid values:

SYSTEM: system event.
CUSTOM: custom event
parameters.help_zh:
事件报警规则的类型。取值：

SYSTEM：系统事件。
CUSTOM：自定义事件
parameters.name: event_type

parameters.help_en: The description of the Event-triggered Alert Rule
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The status of the Event-triggered Alert Rule. Valid values:

ENABLED: enabled.
DISABLED: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
事件报警规则的状态。取值：

ENABLED：启用。
DISABLED：禁用
parameters.name: state

fields.help_en: The keyword for event filtering. When the event content contains this keyword, an alert is automatically triggered
fields.help_zh: 事件过滤关键字。当事件内容包含该关键字时，自动触发报警
fields.name: custom_filters

fields.help_en:
The type of the Event-triggered Alert Rule. Valid values of N: 1 to 50. Valid values:

StatusNotification: fault notification.

Exception: exception.

Maintenance: O&M.

*: unlimited
fields.help_zh:
事件报警规则的类型。N的取值范围：1~50。取值：

StatusNotification：故障通知。

Exception：异常。

Maintenance：运维。

*：无限制
fields.name: event_type_list

fields.help_en:
The level of the Event-triggered Alert Rule. Valid values of N: 1 to 50. Valid values:

CRITICAL: critical.

WARN: warning.

INFO: information.

*: all levels
fields.help_zh:
事件报警规则的等级。N的取值范围：1~50。取值：

CRITICAL：严重。

WARN：警告。

INFO：信息。

*：所有等级
fields.name: level_list

fields.help_en: The name of the Event-triggered Alert Rule. Valid values of N: 1 to 50
fields.help_zh: 事件报警规则的名称。N的取值范围：1~50
fields.name: name_list

fields.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud service type. Valid values of N: 1 to 50.

For information about the Alibaba Cloud services supported by Event-triggered Alert Rules, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114972.html
fields.help_zh:
云服务类型。N的取值范围：1~50。

关于事件报警规则支持的云服务，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114972.html
fields.name: product

fields.help_en:
The SQL filter for events. When the event content meets the SQL condition, an alert is automatically triggered.
The syntax of the SQL event filter is consistent with the query syntax of Simple Log Service (SLS)
fields.help_zh:
SQL事件过滤。当事件内容满足SQL条件时，自动触发报警。
SQL事件过滤的语法与日志服务SLS的查询语法保持一致
fields.name: sql_filter

fields.help_en: The status of the Event-triggered Alert Rule. Valid values of N: 1 to 50
fields.help_zh: 事件报警规则的状态。N的取值范围：1~50
fields.name: status_list

parameters.help_en: The pattern of the Event-triggered Alert Rule
parameters.name: event_pattern

Code.description_en:
The status code.

A value of 200 indicates success

Data.description_en: The number of rows affected when the Event-triggered Alert Rule is created or modified
Data.description_zh: 创建或修改事件报警规则时，返回影响的行数

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was successful. Valid values:

true: The operation was successful.

false: The operation failed
Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：

true：成功。

false：失败
